query: WITH citizens_with_violations AS (SELECT v.violator_id, v.control_number, v.gdate_happened, d.birth_date, FLOOR(DATEDIFF(v.gdate_happened, d.birth_date) / 365.25) AS age_at_violation FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation AS v JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala AS d ON v.violator_id = d.id WHERE v.status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid') AND v.gdate_happened BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND d.person_type = 'Saudi' AND NOT d.birth_date IS NULL AND d.birth_date > '1900-01-01'), higher_education_citizens AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala WHERE TRIM(qualification) IN ('ماجستير', 'دكتوراه')), lower_education_citizens AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala WHERE TRIM(qualification) IN ('بكالوريوس', 'دبلوم عالي', 'دبلوم متوسط')), higher_ed_population /* Get total population in each education group (age 30-50 in 2023-2025) */ AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT he.id) AS population_count FROM higher_education_citizens AS he JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala AS d ON he.id = d.id WHERE d.person_type = 'Saudi' AND NOT d.birth_date IS NULL AND /* Calculate age as of 2024 (midpoint) to be between 30-50 */ FLOOR(DATEDIFF('2024-01-01', d.birth_date) / 365.25) BETWEEN 30 AND 50), lower_ed_population AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT le.id) AS population_count FROM lower_education_citizens AS le JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala AS d ON le.id = d.id WHERE d.person_type = 'Saudi' AND NOT d.birth_date IS NULL AND FLOOR(DATEDIFF('2024-01-01', d.birth_date) / 365.25) BETWEEN 30 AND 50) SELECT 'حاصل على شهادات عليا (ماجستير-دكتوراه)' AS education_group, (SELECT population_count FROM higher_ed_population) AS population_30_50, COUNT(DISTINCT cv.violator_id) AS violators_count, COUNT(*) AS total_infringements, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT population_count FROM higher_ed_population), 4) AS violation_rate_per_person FROM citizens_with_violations AS cv WHERE cv.age_at_violation BETWEEN 30 AND 50 AND cv.violator_id IN (SELECT id FROM higher_education_citizens) UNION ALL SELECT 'خريجين بدون شهادات عليا' AS education_group, (SELECT population_count FROM lower_ed_population) AS population_30_50, COUNT(DISTINCT cv.violator_id) AS violators_count, COUNT(*) AS total_infringements, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT population_count FROM lower_ed_population), 4) AS violation_rate_per_person FROM citizens_with_violations AS cv WHERE cv.age_at_violation BETWEEN 30 AND 50 AND cv.violator_id IN (SELECT id FROM lower_education_citizens) LIMIT 1200
